name: Famine
summary: IPC warns of growing famine risk in Darfur and Kordofan; El Niño threatens Somalia
state: An IPC alert on 12 Oct warned of a growing risk of famine in parts of Greater Darfur and Greater Kordofan in Sudan, where drought affects about half the country (WHO). The IPC's Somalia analysis projects worsening food insecurity for October–December. No current IPC Phase 5 classification was confirmed as of 4 Nov.
for_you: Aid agencies' appeals are the main route for public support.
rubric_hit: Risk-of-famine alerts = Watch; no confirmed Phase 5

sources.title: WHO — IPC Sudan food insecurity and malnutrition alert
IPC — Somalia acute food insecurity, Oct–Dec 2026 projection

why: Famine is the most extreme humanitarian failure, almost always man-made by conflict.
drivers: War, sieges, aid access, harvest failure, funding cuts.

rubric.alert: Famine (IPC Phase 5) confirmed in at least one area.
rubric.watch: IPC Phase 5 projected or 'risk of famine' alerts.
rubric.normal: No IPC Phase 5 (Famine) classifications or projections.
